verses.text: Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised, in the city of our God, in his holy mountain.
lines: Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised,
in the city of our God, in his holy mountain.

verses.text: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, is Mount Zion, on the north sides, the city of the great King.
lines: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth,
is Mount Zion, on the north sides,
the city of the great King.

verses.text: God has shown himself in her citadels as a refuge.
lines: God has shown himself in her citadels as a refuge.

verses.text: For, behold, the kings assembled themselves, they passed by together.
lines: For, behold, the kings assembled themselves,
they passed by together.

verses.text: They saw it, then they were amazed. They were dismayed. They hurried away.
lines: They saw it, then they were amazed.
They were dismayed.
They hurried away.

verses.text: Trembling took hold of them there, pain, as of a woman in travail.
lines: Trembling took hold of them there,
pain, as of a woman in travail.

verses.text: With the east wind, you break the ships of Tarshish.
lines: With the east wind, you break the ships of Tarshish.

verses.text: As we have heard, so we have seen, in the city of Yahweh of Armies, in the city of our God. God will establish it forever.
lines: As we have heard, so we have seen,
in the city of Yahweh of Armies, in the city of our God.
God will establish it forever.

verses.text: We have thought about your loving kindness, God, in the middle of your temple.
lines: We have thought about your loving kindness, God,
in the middle of your temple.

verses.text: As is your name, God, so is your praise to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full of righteousness.
lines: As is your name, God,
so is your praise to the ends of the earth.
Your right hand is full of righteousness.

verses.text: Let Mount Zion be glad! Let the daughters of Judah rejoice because of your judgments.
lines: Let Mount Zion be glad!
Let the daughters of Judah rejoice because of your judgments.

verses.text: Walk about Zion, and go around her. Number its towers.
lines: Walk about Zion, and go around her.
Number its towers.

verses.text: Notice her bulwarks. Consider her palaces, that you may tell it to the next generation.
lines: Notice her bulwarks.
Consider her palaces,
that you may tell it to the next generation.

verses.text: For this God is our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even to death.
lines: For this God is our God forever and ever.
He will be our guide even to death.
